power.method: 10000mAh rechargeable battery; 8W solar panel included (charges to -15C)

release_notes: Dual-lens wire-free AOV battery camera (fixed wide + PT lens). Sensor, focal lengths, IP rating and codecs not stated on accessible official sources. Corrected 2026-10-30 against the official Imou spec sheet: added model code IPC-SA70F-10M0T2-EU/FSP008, sensor 1/3" CMOS, max resolution 2880x1620 per lens, 3.6 mm fixed + 3.6 mm PT lenses, FOV 76 H / 41 V / 91 D, H.265/H.264 up to 15 fps.

frigate.notes: 100% wire-free battery camera — it sleeps between events and does not expose a continuous local RTSP stream, so Frigate/local-NVR use is not supported. Recording is via the Imou Life app + cloud and on-device microSD.

field_of_view_deg: 76 H / 41 V / 91 D; fixed lens 260 horizontal / 25 vertical; PT lens pan 340 / tilt 90
